name: Lee Hill → Lefthand → St. Vrain
description: St Vrain is the best. Had vague notions of this being a bigger ride but 1) not feeling very fit today and 2) my bike has a few issues so I’m going to take it to the shop. A wire popped out and brushed my leg on every pedal and I thought I’d figure it out in Ward but later I looked down and a shocking amount of blood had soaked into my sock and splashed onto my bike. A nice guy also pointed out to me that my saddle was way too high which I guess I didn’t account for when I changed my stem. Bikes are hard. Might want a new bike fit but I kinda want to sell this bike and get a new one before that just not sure when that will be possible.
